page_title: MK Ultra Marijuana Strain - Kind Green Buds

source_page_metadata.description: Explore the MK Ultra marijuana strain - THC levels, genetics, terpene profile, effects, flavor, and grow tips.

article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Indica-dominant Hybrid
Genetics: OG Kush × G13
Breeder: T.H. Seeds
THC Content: 18%–23%
CBD Content: Low (typically under 1%)
Terpene Profile: Myrcene , Caryophyllene , Limonene
Primary Flavors: Earthy pine, Hash spice, Herbal
Flowering Time (Indoor): 8–9 weeks
Outdoor Harvest Time: Early October
Indoor Yield: 14–18 oz per m²
Outdoor Yield: 16–20 oz per plant
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Few marijuana strains carry a name as mysterious as MK Ultra , and the experience it delivers often lives up to the intrigue. This indica-dominant cultivar, developed by T.H. Seeds, blends heavy physical relaxation with a hypnotic mental calm that can feel almost dreamlike when the dose is strong. Rather than producing an abrupt punch of psychoactivity, the strain gradually wraps the user in a dense, tranquil atmosphere that makes the outside world feel pleasantly distant.

For cannabis enthusiasts who appreciate powerful nighttime weed, MK Ultra has long held a respected place in dispensary menus. Its reputation grew quickly after winning awards shortly after release, and it continues to attract attention for the way it merges OG Kush’s unmistakable potency with the legendary mystique of G-13 genetics. The result is a cultivar that favors stillness over stimulation, making it particularly appealing when the goal is deep relaxation and mental quiet.
Genetics and Lineage

MK Ultra was bred by T.H. Seeds, a company that gained recognition for developing high-quality cannabis hybrids during the early expansion of the modern seed market. The cultivar is the product of two well-known marijuana lineages: G-13 and OG Kush, each contributing distinctive characteristics to the final plant.

G-13 has long existed as one of the most famous legends in cannabis culture. Stories surrounding its origin suggest it was once part of a secret government breeding project, though the details remain largely speculative. Regardless of mythology, G-13 varieties are widely respected for their powerful indica effects, compact growth patterns, and heavy resin production. This side of the lineage contributes to the deep body relaxation and dense bud structure often observed in MK Ultra plants.

The other parent, OG Kush, represents one of the most influential cannabis strains in modern breeding. Known for its pungent aroma and exceptionally strong psychoactive profile, OG Kush has shaped the genetic foundation of countless modern hybrids. Its contribution adds complexity to the terpene profile while also enhancing potency and resin density.

Combining these two influential cultivars created a marijuana strain with formidable strength and rich aromatic character. The fusion of OG Kush intensity and G-13’s heavy indica influence results in a hybrid that leans strongly toward physical relaxation while still offering a pleasant mental uplift early in the experience.
Effects and Experience

The initial moments of the experience often begin with a subtle shift in mental clarity. A light cerebral lift appears first, bringing a warm sense of contentment that gently replaces tension or mental clutter. Rather than accelerating thoughts, the sensation tends to slow the pace of the mind, creating a calm and contemplative mood.

As the high progresses, the physical effects gradually become more pronounced. Muscles begin to loosen, and a steady wave of relaxation spreads throughout the body. Many cannabis consumers notice a growing heaviness in the limbs, often accompanied by a comfortable warmth that encourages sitting back or lying down. The body-centered effects can feel immersive, especially when higher THC levels are involved.

Eventually the strain settles into its most recognizable phase—a deeply tranquil state that borders on sedation. Conversation becomes quieter, movement slows, and the mind drifts toward a peaceful stillness. For this reason, the cultivar is widely favored as an evening or nighttime weed. When consumed late in the day, the calming progression often transitions naturally into restful sleep.
Medical Benefits

Within medical cannabis community , MK Ultra is frequently associated with strong relaxation and physical relief. Patients dealing with chronic stress or persistent tension may find the strain’s calming influence helpful in easing mental pressure. The slow, soothing progression of effects can create an environment where the mind feels less burdened by daily worries.

Another commonly discussed benefit involves sleep support. Because the cultivar gradually builds toward sedation, many patients use it as part of an evening routine when insomnia or restless sleep becomes a problem. The combination of physical heaviness and mental calm can make it easier for the body to transition into deeper rest.

Physical discomfort is another area where this marijuana strain may provide assistance. The strong body effects sometimes help reduce sensations associated with muscle tightness, inflammation , or chronic pain conditions. While results vary between individuals, the cultivar’s potent indica characteristics often make it appealing for patients seeking a cannabis option that emphasizes relaxation rather than stimulation.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Breaking apart a nug of MK Ultra releases a complex aroma that blends earthy richness with sharp, pine-like intensity. The fragrance immediately reflects its OG Kush ancestry, offering a pungent mixture of forest floor, damp soil, and spicy herbs. Beneath that foundation lies a subtle citrus brightness that adds depth to the overall scent.

Once the buds are ground, additional layers begin to emerge. Notes of wood, pepper, and faint sweetness appear alongside a distinctive herbal sharpness. These aromatic qualities are largely driven by a terpene profile dominated by myrcene, caryophyllene, and limonene, compounds that contribute both to flavor complexity and to the strain’s calming physical effects.

The taste follows a similar pattern when the cannabis is smoked or vaporized. The inhale often carries earthy pine and subtle lemon zest, while the exhale leaves behind a peppery, slightly woody aftertaste. The lingering flavor tends to remain on the palate, offering a classic “Kush-style” finish that many seasoned marijuana enthusiasts recognize immediately.
Growing Information

From a cultivation standpoint, MK Ultra offers several characteristics that appeal to experienced growers. The plants typically remain relatively compact, producing thick stems and tight internodal spacing. This growth pattern makes the cultivar suitable for indoor environments where vertical space may be limited.

The flowering phase generally lasts 8 to 9 weeks, which is considered relatively fast compared to many cannabis strains. During this period, dense clusters of buds develop along the branches, often coated in heavy layers of trichomes. Adequate ventilation becomes important because the thick flowers can retain moisture if airflow is insufficient.

Growers often report that the plant responds well to pruning and training techniques. Methods such as topping or low-stress training can encourage additional branching, which helps increase overall yields. Under optimal conditions, the cultivar can produce a generous harvest of sticky, resin-rich buds with a strong aroma that intensifies during the final weeks of flowering.
FAQ
Is MK Ultra indica or sativa? The strain is considered an indica-dominant hybrid. Its effects emphasize body relaxation and sedation rather than energetic mental stimulation.
How strong is MK Ultra cannabis? THC levels commonly range between 18% and 23%, making it a relatively potent marijuana strain. Higher doses can produce very strong physical effects.
What does MK Ultra smell like? The aroma combines earthy pine, spicy herbs, citrus hints, and classic OG Kush fuel-like notes, creating a complex and pungent scent.
Is MK Ultra good for sleep? Many cannabis consumers prefer this cultivar as a nighttime option because the relaxing effects often build into deep sedation that may support sleep.
How long does MK Ultra take to flower? Indoor growers typically harvest after 8–9 weeks of flowering, although exact timing may vary depending on growing conditions and phenotype.
Final Thoughts on MK Ultra

MK Ultra continues to hold a respected place among classic indica cannabis strains . By combining the mysterious legacy of G-13 with the powerhouse genetics of OG Kush, T.H. Seeds created a cultivar that emphasizes depth, potency, and relaxation. Its ability to gradually guide the mind and body into a tranquil state has helped maintain its popularity for years.

The strain’s layered terpene profile also contributes to its enduring appeal. Earthy pine, herbal spice, and subtle citrus create a fragrance that feels both traditional and distinctive, reflecting the genetic heritage behind the plant. For enthusiasts who appreciate bold Kush aromas, this cultivar rarely disappoints.

When taken together, the relaxing effects, strong resin production, and balanced genetics make MK Ultra a notable option within the broader cannabis landscape. Whether enjoyed for evening relaxation, creative introspection, or simply the pleasure of its rich flavor profile, this hybrid remains a memorable example of how powerful marijuana breeding can produce strains with both character and lasting reputation.
